worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.summary: Kowtow first to make the target drop its guard and crack open, then lunge in and slash; it only connects at true contact with a clear line, and once in contact it makes no random miss, knocking the target back. If it cannot catch up, is walled off, or the target leaves, it swings at nothing, and an empty aim swings too.
worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.descripti: The slash deals about %1$s damage with no accuracy roll once in contact; against a target still carrying the opening its power is %2$s higher.
The kowtow only works on a nearby valid target within %3$s blocks: it drops that target by %1$s stage of Defence and opens a %2$s s opening; cleaving it during that window gains the bonus above.

After the bow the user closes in each tick by %1$s blocks, with the move's range as the total budget; a hit knocks the target back %2$s blocks with a %3$s block hit radius. When the budget runs out, a wall blocks the way, or the target leaves, it swings at nothing on the spot.
The bow and the blade are %1$s s apart.
worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.growth.1: At level %1$s: slash power %2$s, lunge step %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.use.1: Crack a brief opening on the target
worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.use.2: Land a heavier cut on a high-Defence target
worldcombat.skill.kowtowcleave.preferenc: On: a deeper kowtow opens one more stage of Defence drop, +0.15 bonus and 20 ticks longer, but with 4 ticks more windup and 6 ticks more cooldown. Off: a quick bow and blade, cheaper and faster.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of kowtowing. Larger values let it pounce from further.
On: it prefers to bow on a healthy target that is not already carrying the opening; off: order it like a plain melee attack.
On: the user may leave its post to close on a target; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
